items.title: Contract freeze: scaffold, shared/contract.ts (Node-importable dayKey + ScanEvent + routes), tokens.css, Plate.tsx, canonical shared fixture Snapshot + contract-lock test, vitest config with TZ pinned, package.json with all pinned deps
items.acceptance: The contract-lock test passes and fails if any status enum value, attention comparator ordering (dirty > unpushed > stale, ties by recency), ScanEvent shape, or the canonical fixture Snapshot drifts from shared/contract.ts, with vitest running non-interactively under a pinned TZ
items.notes: verified cycle 3: 37/37 green, plain-node import ok, mutation probe failed suite as required

items.title: Git plumbing facts per repo: branch, porcelain dirty, ahead/behind vs @{u}, 12-month author-date log, last-touched files, branch list — tolerant of worktrees, empty repos, detached HEAD
items.acceptance: Against fixture repos including a .git-file worktree, an empty zero-commit repo, a detached-HEAD checkout, and a branch with no upstream, every repo yields a partial RepoSummary (never a thrown scan failure), with upstream reported as none rather than a zero ahead-count — including an explicit fixture pinning that rev-list --left-right --count parse order reports a behind-only repo as behind, never ahead

items.title: Attention classification and ranking engine: dirty/unpushed/stale/ok flags and pre-ordered AttentionEntry[]
items.acceptance: Given a matrix of repo states, the emitted queue orders dirty before unpushed before stale with ties broken by most-recent activity, the >90-day stale boundary is exact, and a repo with upstream none is labeled no-remote and never unpushed

items.title: Scanner: depth-limited ~/Projects walk with directory pruning, bounded-concurrency survey, LOC classifier with caps, local-timezone day bucketing, atomic JSON disk cache
items.acceptance: A scan over temp-dir fixture repos produces a contract-conforming Snapshot with heatmap counts keyed by author-date local-timezone dayKey, LOC-by-extension excluding node_modules/dist/.git/vendored via walk-time pruning (never entered), per-repo progress callbacks firing done/total, and an atomically written .atlas-cache.json that loads intact on next boot

items.title: HTTP server on :4600: static dist, cache-first GET /api/atlas, POST /api/rescan async job, GET /api/scan-events SSE progress, GET /api/repo/:id
items.acceptance: With an injected fixture scanner, GET /api/atlas returns the cached Snapshot instantly, POST /api/rescan returns before the scan completes, /api/scan-events emits contract ScanEvents in order ending with a terminal completion event after which /api/atlas serves the fresh data without a server restart, and /api/repo/:id returns drill-down detail
items.notes: verified cycle 6: per-merge tests + live boot smoke + look pass

items.title: Hand-rolled SVG chart suite: Heatmap with day-click cross-filter emit, Timeline honoring the day filter, Sparkline, Strata LOC bar
items.acceptance: Rendered from the shared fixture Snapshot, the heatmap draws the exact expected 53x7 cell counts with correct month labels using the contract dayKey, clicking a day cell emits that date as a filter which the Timeline visibly narrows to, and all four charts render safely on empty data

items.title: Data and UX hooks: useAtlas with injectable SSE transport + polling fallback, useTheme, useKeyboardNav; mount test for every exported hook
items.acceptance: Every exported hook mounts cleanly in a component-mount test using an injected mock transport (no EventSource in jsdom), and useAtlas swaps in fresh Snapshot data atomically on the terminal scan event — falling back to /api/atlas polling when the SSE transport is unavailable

items.title: App shell + Overview folio: masthead, hash routing, Fig. 1 Notices attention queue, Fig. 2/3 heatmap+timeline with cross-filter wiring, Fig. 4 Legend stats row, Fig. 5 Gazetteer with search/sort, ScanBar rescan progress
items.acceptance: Mounted on the shared fixture Snapshot, the overview shows the attention queue in server-delivered order with reason badges (including no-remote) strictly above the aggregate heatmap and timeline, every fixture repo appears in the Gazetteer table with branch/state/last-commit and live search/sort, and clicking Rescan shows n/total progress from scan events
items.notes: verified cycle 6: per-merge tests + live boot smoke + look pass

items.title: Per-repo drill-down plate set: repo-scoped heatmap + timeline, Strata language/LOC, commit ledger, last-touched files, branch list
items.acceptance: Opening a fixture repo drill-down renders its languages/LOC strata, recent commits, last-touched files, and branch list (current branch marked, upstream/no-remote state shown), with the heatmap and timeline scoped to that repo data only

items.title: Cmd+K fuzzy repo-jump palette layered on j/k keyboard navigation
items.acceptance: Pressing Cmd+K opens a fuzzy-matching palette over the fixture repo set and choosing a match navigates to that repo drill-down, with Escape closing the palette without navigating
items.notes: verified cycle 7 live: Cmd+K/Ctrl+K open, mktl->mocktail, Enter navigates, Escape/backdrop safe

items.title: Integration against the real ~/Projects: clean rebuild-then-serve (no stale dist), DoD walk-through, cross-filter and palette seam wiring, tokens-only visual audit, README
items.acceptance: From a clean checkout with dist deleted, npm start serves the dashboard at http://localhost:4600 in under 2 seconds from cache, listing every git repo under ~/Projects with correct branch/dirty/last-commit, working drill-down and heatmap day-click cross-filter, and a Rescan that updates data live without restarting the server
items.notes: verified cycle 9: README fact-checked against code (port, scripts, strict-90d, cache path)

items.title: Attention queue omits dirty repos whose lastCommit is null (zero-commit repos) — include dirty repos regardless of commit history
items.acceptance: A dirty repo with zero commits (lastCommit null) appears in the attention queue with reason dirty (lastActivityIso falls back sensibly), and the Notices count matches the Gazetteer dirty count
items.notes: verified cycle 7 live: both zero-commit dirty repos in queue, parity 23=23

items.title: Chart edge cases from look pass: Sparkline reading collides with rising line; empty-window Heatmap month labels overlap (Dec/Jan); Heatmap renders future days as observed; Strata empty state is a blank block
items.acceptance: Sparkline reading never overlaps its line, an empty-activity heatmap window shows non-overlapping month labels and no cells after the snapshot day, and an empty Strata renders an explicit empty-state message like neighboring plates
items.notes: verified cycle 8 live (hard-reloaded page): sparkline readings stepped left + clear of ink band; mocktail labels 12 no overlaps (stub Dec dropped); strata empty 20px tall with width=240

items.title: Notices rows for zero-commit repos render epoch age (20679d) — show em-dash like the Gazetteer
items.acceptance: An attention row whose lastActivityIso is the epoch fallback (1970-01-01) shows an em-dash (or no-commits marker) in the age slot, never a days-since-epoch figure
items.notes: verified cycle 9: em-dash renders for epoch fallback, 22/22 Overview tests

items.title: Server SSE + snapshot lifecycle fixes: scan-events stream must not res.end() a 200 SSE (EventSource reconnect loop replaying stale done); clear retained events after scan; generatedAt must be string per contract (never null); sequence cache-seed vs scan-completion writers
items.acceptance: One completed scan delivers exactly one terminal done to a persistent EventSource client over 15s (no reconnect replay loop), /api/atlas before any scan returns a contract-valid snapshot, and a late cache seed can never overwrite a fresher scan result
items.notes: verified cycle 11: conductor persistent-SSE probe — exactly 1 terminal done in 20s window (41 events), suite 208 green

items.title: Working-tree state in the scan: gitFacts/scan emit workingTree {staged[],modified[],untracked[]} per repo (taste fundamental — server half)
items.acceptance: A dirty fixture repo’s RepoSummary carries workingTree lists matching git status --porcelain exactly (staged/modified/untracked, capped at 50 each with a total count), and clean repos carry empty lists
items.notes: verified cycle 14 live: swarm workingTree 3 modified 3 untracked == git porcelain 6 entries; clean repo empty lists

items.title: Fig. 9a — Unlogged Cargo: dirty repo drill-down shows uncommitted files + header counts (taste fundamental — UI half)
items.acceptance: Opening a dirty repo’s plate shows an Unlogged Cargo section listing modified/untracked/staged files with counts (and the dirty header badge shows ‘n modified, n untracked’); clean repos show no such section
items.notes: verified cycle 14 live: Fig 9a between Fig 8/9, badge dirty — 3 modified, 3 untracked

items.title: Preserve Notices queue selection across drill-down round-trips (taste notable #5)
items.acceptance: After Enter into a repo plate and Back, the queue selection sits on the previously selected row (j advances to the next), verified in a mount test
items.notes: verified cycle 14: v2 branch (module-fallback removed, storage-only + test hygiene) 228/228 x18 runs
